_what: What a person sees, per repo type. land's gates block reads this (and only this) to decide whether a PR needs a 'Ship-ready: PASS' line, and which added files mean something NEW goes public ('Launch-ready: PASS'). Patterns are POSIX ERE matched against repo-relative paths. A type applies when any path on origin/main matches its detect pattern; 'everywhere' applies to every repo. Decided 20 Nov 2026 from the layouts of every seq23 repo under ~/GitHub.

types._layout: static and framework sites: p-n-p, secondaries, spry-vc, sprylabs-hpc-site, local-guides-*, cynthia-brown-dds-site, 901johnsons-site (next), courtscope (astro), peace-be-still and keepmyproof site/
Workers + React consoles: boss-os, west-peek-os (src/client/), creator-studios and the creator dashboards (app/, help/)
Expo apps: keepmyproof, aplayer-mode apps/mobile, approvalprep, dream-wedding-builder (app/, store/ listings and screenshots)
video and social output: how-we-know (channel/, captions/, renders/, visuals/), peace-be-still audio/, creator-studios studios/

review._what: Where a review class shows in the PATHS a PR changes (her list of 27 Nov 2026). land's review_class reads this only when a PR's description has no usable 'Review class:' line: a diff touching none of these is inferred 'none' and lands on green CI; a diff touching one is asked for the line (REVIEW_CLASS_UNDECLARED), never guessed. A match never demands a reviewer by itself: the declared class does. Matched case-insensitively against each changed path that 'exclude' above does not drop (tests and docs). Structure only: these name where such code lives, never what a change means.

data_store._what: private-data has no honest path test (any code can read a person's record). So in a repo whose main holds a data store, every PR that changes more than tests and docs keeps the declared line. A repo holds one when a path on main matches 'paths', or a wrangler config on main names one of 'bindings'.
